rows.label: qst500204_msg0001
rows.name:
I was just lamenting the transience
of human life, mo.

rows.label: qst500204_msg0002
rows.name:
Invidians and Superbians seem to like
war, mo.

rows.label: qst500204_msg0003
rows.name:
Nopon don't wage wars, but there is
still competition, mo.

rows.label: qst500204_msg0004
rows.name:
Peace means no winners or losers, but
if there are winners and losers, you
have no choice but to win, mo.

rows.label: qst500204_msg0006
rows.name:
The Fortis Trade Guild travel guide
says competition is a business
opportunity, mo.

rows.label: qst500204_msg0007
rows.name:
I'll sell the Damp Shimeji I brought
to the Invidian army and use the money
to fund my travels, mooo!

rows.label: qst500204_msg0008
rows.name:
Anyway, maybe we meet
again. Best of luck!
